title: The Twelve Greatnesses Descending to Adam
description: The longest single teaching of the seeking-section. T15 traces the redemptive descent of divine truth from the hidden Father — in silence and concealment in his own substance — through the Mother of Life, the First Man with the rational already articulated in five degrees, the Living Spirit as operative power, the Third Ambassador as call, the Jesus the Radiance as illumining wisdom, all the way down to Adam and Eve's flesh, and home again in the Last Andrias. This is the macro-arc the soul has been seeking the whole long way through the city — the whole descent and return seen at once.
